ITEM 1 | Dense pile of dark green, glossy-looking leafy greens with flat oval leaves and visible pale stems, occupying roughly 40% of the plate diameter, moist with slight sheen, leaves folded and overlapping, lying on a white square plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Small bright red diced pieces, glossy and firm, about 1 cm each, scattered among the greens near the center-left | 8
ITEM 3 | Small pale off-white cubes with slightly golden edges, about 1 cm, firm and irregular, sitting among the leaves near the center | 6
ITEM 4 | Thin pale yellowish-orange strips, a few mm wide and 2-3 cm long, limp and translucent-looking, tucked among leaves at top center | 4
ITEM 5 | Small dark purple-black pieces, about 0.5 cm, glossy, scattered sparingly among the greens | 2
ITEM 6 | Glossy oily sheen on the leaves and a thin film of dressing-like moisture pooled lightly around the greens, clear to pale amber, spread over the leaf surfaces | 10
